description: This Java class 'NetListMerge' is a utility for merging specific sections ('components', 'libparts', 'libraries', 'nets') from multiple KiCad netlist files. It uses regex patterns to extract and concatenate these sections from input files and produce a combined output.

classes.name: NetListMerge
classes.description: Main class providing static methods to parse netlist files, merge sections, and execute the utility logic.

classes.name: NetContent
classes.description: Inner static class representing the parsed sections ('header', 'components', 'libparts', 'libraries', 'nets') of a netlist file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the utility; processes command-line arguments, reads, merges, and writes netlist sections.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a netlist file content string, extracting predefined sections using regex matchers.
